posts.t: Kirby Dach shoves Artyom Levshunov to the ice. Connor Bedard comes to his defense.
The fourth line ties up the game through Evans, assists to Dach and Beck 1-1 #GoHabsGo
Nice aggression from Owen Beck and patience from Kirby Dach sets up Jake Evans with an enourmous amount of time and space to tie the game.
